correctness.rationale: Centering the two source parallelograms in the common basis \(u=(1,1)\), \(v=(-1/2,1/2)\) gives the rectangle half-widths \(a_\lambda=(2-\lambda)/4\) and \(b_\lambda=(1+\lambda)/2\). The transformed lattice has rows of phases \(\mathbb Z\) and \(\mathbb Z+1/2\) alternating with unit vertical spacing. A scaled rectangle covers either with one active row, requiring vertical half-width at least \(1/2\) and horizontal half-width at least \(1/2\), or with two opposite-phase rows, requiring vertical half-width at least \(1\) and horizontal half-width at least \(1/4\). These conditions are both necessary and sufficient, giving the minimum of the two stated maxima. Substitution yields exactly \(2/(2-\lambda)\) and \(2/(1+\lambda)\), switching at \(\lambda=1/2\).
